name: Student personal records (PII)
rationale: C: disclosure of PII for many students = serious harm to individuals; I: wrong contact/identity data disrupts services but is correctable; A: short outage only delays lookups

name: Grades and academic history
rationale: I: source of record for transcripts (A-03), undetected tampering = severe; C: grade disclosure = serious privacy harm; A: needed during registration (A-02)

name: Graduation status and degree data
rationale: I: falsified graduation status leads to wrongly issued degrees (A-03) = severe; C: largely published at graduation; A: used a few times per year

name: Accounts credentials and role assignments
rationale: C/I: admin credential or role compromise exposes or alters all of C-03 = severe; A: loss blocks all access (serious)

name: Backup copies of C-03
rationale: Inherits AS-01..AS-03 sensitivity; I/A: only recovery path after destruction or tampering

name: Portal service (registration lookup)
rationale: A: outage during registration week = serious (A-02); I: defacement or wrong display = serious loss of trust

name: SSO authentication for the portal
rationale: Single login path for C-01/C-07 (PC-01); outage or tampering blocks or misroutes all users

name: Cloud infrastructure configuration
rationale: I: misconfiguration can expose or destroy C-03 and C-05 together = severe

name: Admin workstations
rationale: I: compromised workstation gives an attacker admin sessions to C-02/C-03/C-06

name: Audit logs
rationale: I: altered or missing logs prevent detecting grade tampering (supports AS-02/AS-03)
